product.description: The Velara ProGrip 500 tripod offers a lightweight yet robust solution for photographers seeking stability across a range of shooting scenarios. Constructed from a hybrid frame of aluminum alloy and carbon‑fiber rods, the unit folds to a compact 30 cm height for easy transport while extending to 120 cm for maximum reach. A quick‑release plate and adjustable leg locks provide secure mounting for DSLR, mirrorless, or compact cameras. The matte black finish resists scratches, and the integrated cable management keeps accessories tidy. Designed for both studio and on‑the‑go use, the ProGrip 500 balances durability with portability, making it a reliable companion for any photography enthusiast.
